1.english_reference: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ בַּ שָּׁנָ֣ה הָ רְבִיעִ֔ת לִ יהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ τῷ τετάρτῳ Ἰωακεὶμ υἱοῦ Ἰωσεία βασιλέως Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: Et factum est in anno quarto Ióakim fílii Iosíæ regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , [

1.english_reference: that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying

traditions.WLC: הָיָ֞ה הַ דָּבָ֤ר הַ זֶּה֙ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵ אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: ἐγενήθη λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: factum est verbum hoc ad Ieremíam a Dómino , dicens :
traditions.KJV: that ] this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD , saying ,

2.english_reference: Take thee a roll of a book

traditions.WLC: קַח לְ ךָ֮ מְגִלַּת סֵפֶר֒
traditions.LXX: Λάβε σεαυτῷ χαρτίον βιβλίου ,
traditions.VUL: Tolle volúmen libri ,
traditions.KJV: Take thee a roll of a book ,

2.english_reference: and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations

traditions.WLC: וְ כָתַבְתָּ֣ אֵלֶ֗י הָ אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ דְּבָרִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֵלֶ֛י ךָ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וְ עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ עַל כָּל הַ גּוֹיִ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ γράψον ἐπ᾽ αὐτοῦ πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐλάλησα πρὸς σὲ ἐπὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἐπὶ Ἰουδὰ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη
traditions.VUL: et scribes in eo ómnia verba , quæ locútus sum tibi advérsum Israel et Iudam , et advérsum omnes gentes :
traditions.KJV: and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel , and against Judah , and against all the nations ,

2.english_reference: from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day

traditions.WLC: מִ יּ֞וֹם דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֨י ךָ֙ מִ ימֵ֣י יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וְ עַ֖ד הַ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: ἀφ᾽ ἧς ἡμέρας λαλήσαντός μου πρὀς σέ , ἀφ᾽ ἡμερῶν Ἰωσεία βασιλέως Ἰούδα καὶ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης .
traditions.VUL: a die , qua locútus sum ad te ex diébus Iosíæ usque ad diem hanc :
traditions.KJV: from the day I spake unto thee , from the days of Josiah , even unto this day .

3.english_reference: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them

traditions.WLC: אוּלַ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ֣ רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֖ב לַ עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἴσως ἀκούσεται ὁ οἶκος Ἰούδα πάντα τὰ κακὰ ἃ ἐγὼ λογίζομαι ποιῆσαι αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: si forte audiénte domo Iuda univérsa mala , quæ ego cógito fácere eis ,
traditions.KJV: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them ;

3.english_reference: that they may return every man from his evil way

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֣עַן יָשׁ֗וּבוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִ דַּרְכּ֣ וֹ הָ רָעָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἵνα ἀποστρέψωσιν ἀπὸ ὁδοῦ αὐτῶν τῆς πονηρᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: revertátur unusquísque a via sua péssima :
traditions.KJV: that they may return every man from his evil way ;

3.english_reference: that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin

traditions.WLC: וְ סָלַחְתִּ֥י לַ עֲוֺנָ֖ ם וּ לְ חַטָּאתָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἵλεως ἔσομαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et propítius ero iniquitáti , et peccáto eórum .
traditions.KJV: that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin .

4.english_reference: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֣א יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ἰερεμίας τὸν Βαροὺχ υἱὸν Νηρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Vocávit ergo Ieremías Baruch fílium Neríæ :
traditions.KJV: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah :

4.english_reference: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְתֹּ֨ב בָּר֜וּךְ מִ פִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלָ֖י ו עַל מְגִלַּת סֵֽפֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔγραψεν ἀπὸ στόματος Ἰερεμίου πάντας τοὺς λόγους Κυρίου , οὓς ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτόν , εἰς χαρτίον βιβλίου .
traditions.VUL: et scripsit Baruch ex ore Ieremíæ omnes sermónes Dómini , quos locútus est ad eum in volúmine libri :
traditions.KJV: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD , which he had spoken unto him , upon a roll of a book .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַוֶּ֣ה יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת בָּר֖וּךְ לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Ἰερεμίας τῷ Βαροὺχ λέγων
traditions.VUL: et præcépit Ieremías Baruch , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch , saying ,

traditions.WLC: אֲנִ֣י עָצ֔וּר
traditions.LXX: Ἐγὼ φυλάσσομαι ,
traditions.VUL: Ego clausus sum ,
traditions.KJV: I [ am ] shut up ;

5.english_reference: I can not go into the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל לָ ב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴ δύνωμαι εἰσελθεῖν εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: nec váleo íngredi domum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: I can not go into the house of the LORD :

6.english_reference: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD ’S house upon the fasting day

traditions.WLC: וּ בָאתָ֣ אַתָּ֡ה וְ קָרָ֣אתָ בַ מְּגִלָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַֽבְתָּ מִ פִּ י֩ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה בְּ אָזְנֵ֥י הָ עָ֛ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בְּ י֣וֹם צ֑וֹם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναγνώσῃ ἐν τῷ χαρτίῳ τούτῳ εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ νηστείας ,
traditions.VUL: Ingrédere ergo tu , et lege de volúmine , in quo scripsísti ex ore meo verba Dómini , audiénte pópulo in domo Dómini , in die ieiúnii :
traditions.KJV: Therefore go thou , and read in the roll , which thou hast written from my mouth , the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD ’S house upon the fasting day :

6.english_reference: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֨ם בְּ אָזְנֵ֧י כָל יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ בָּאִ֥ים מֵ עָרֵי הֶ֖ם תִּקְרָאֵֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ὠσὶ παντὸς Ἰούδα τῶν ἐρχομένων ἐκ πόλεως αὐτῶν ἀναγνώσῃ αὐτοῖς .
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et audiénte univérso Iuda , qui véniunt de civitátibus suis , leges eis :
traditions.KJV: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities .

7.english_reference: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD

traditions.WLC: אוּלַ֞י תִּפֹּ֤ל תְּחִנָּתָ ם֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἴσως πεσεῖται ἔλεος αὐτῶν κατὰ πρόσωπον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: si forte cadat orátio eórum in conspéctu Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD ,

7.english_reference: and will return every one from his evil way

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִ דַּרְכּ֣ וֹ הָ רָעָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀποστρέψουσιν ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτῶν τῆς πονηρᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: et revertátur unusquísque a via sua péssima :
traditions.KJV: and will return every one from his evil way :

7.english_reference: for great [ is ] the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי גָד֤וֹל הָ אַף֙ וְ הַ֣ חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל הָ עָ֥ם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι μέγας ὁ θυμὸς καὶ ἡ ὀργὴ Κυρίου ἣν ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον .
traditions.VUL: quóniam magnus furor et indignátio est , quam locútus est Dóminus advérsus pópulum hunc .
traditions.KJV: for great [ is ] the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people .

8.english_reference: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֗עַשׂ בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה כְּ כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ הוּ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ נָּבִ֑יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Βαροὺχ κατὰ πάντα ἃ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ Ἰερεμίας ,
traditions.VUL: Et fecit Baruch fílius Neríæ iuxta ómnia , quæ præcéperat ei Ieremías prophéta ,
traditions.KJV: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him ,

8.english_reference: reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD ’S house

traditions.WLC: לִ קְרֹ֥א בַ סֵּ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀναγνῶναι ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ λόγους Κυρίου ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: legens ex volúmine sermónes Dómini in domo Dómini .
traditions.KJV: reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD ’S house .

9.english_reference: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , in the ninth month

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֣י בַ שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠ חֲמִשִׁית לִ יהוֹיָקִ֨ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ בַּ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ תְּשִׁעִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ὀγδόῳ βασιλεῖ Ἰωακεὶμ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἐνάτῳ
traditions.VUL: Factum est autem in anno quinto Ióakim fílii Iosíæ regis Iuda , in mense nono :
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , in the ninth month , [

9.english_reference: that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: קָרְא֨וּ צ֜וֹם לִ פְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה כָּל הָ עָ֖ם בִּ ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐξεκκλησίασαν νηστείαν κατὰ πρόσωπον Κυρίου πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: prædicavérunt ieiúnium in conspéctu Dómini omni pópulo in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: that ] they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem ,

9.english_reference: and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל הָ עָ֗ם הַ בָּאִ֛ים מֵ עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἶκος Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: et univérsæ multitúdini , quæ conflúxerat de civitátibus Iuda in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem .

10.english_reference: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֨א בָר֥וּךְ בַּ סֵּ֛פֶר אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνεγίνωσκε βαροὺχ ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοὺς λόγους Ἰερεμίου ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Legítque Baruch ex volúmine sermónes Ieremíæ in domo Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD ,

10.english_reference: in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe

traditions.WLC: בְּ לִשְׁכַּ֡ת גְּמַרְיָהוּ֩ בֶן שָׁפָ֨ן הַ סֹּפֵ֜ר
traditions.LXX: ἐν οἴκῳ Γαμαρείου υἱοῦ Σαφὰν τοῦ γραμματέως ,
traditions.VUL: in gazophylácio Gamaríæ fílii Saphan scribæ ,
traditions.KJV: in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe ,

10.english_reference: in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD ’S house

traditions.WLC: בֶּ חָצֵ֣ר הָ עֶלְי֗וֹן פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית יְהוָה֙ הֶֽ חָדָ֔שׁ
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῇ ἐπάνω ἐν προθύροις πύλης τοῦ οἴκου Κυρίου τῆς καινῆς
traditions.VUL: in vestíbulo superióri , in intróitu portæ novæ domus Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: in the higher court , at the entry of the new gate of the LORD ’S house ,

10.english_reference: in the ears of all the people

traditions.WLC: בְּ אָזְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ὠσὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ .
traditions.VUL: audiénte omni pópulo .
traditions.KJV: in the ears of all the people .

11.english_reference: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah , the son of Shaphan , had heard

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יִּשְׁמַ֗ע מִכָ֨יְהוּ בֶן גְּמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן שָׁפָ֛ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν Μειχαίας υἱὸς Γαμαρείου υἱοῦ Σαφὰν
traditions.VUL: Cumque audísset Michǽas fílius Gamaríæ fílii Saphan
traditions.KJV: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah , the son of Shaphan , had heard

11.english_reference: out of the book all the words of the LORD

traditions.WLC: אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מֵ עַ֥ל הַ סֵּֽפֶר
traditions.LXX: ἅπαντας τοὺς λόγους Κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ βιβλίου .
traditions.VUL: omnes sermónes Dómini ex libro ,
traditions.KJV: out of the book all the words of the LORD ,

12.english_reference: Then he went down into the king ’s house

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֤רֶד בֵּית הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέβη εἰς οἰκίαν τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: descéndit in domum regis ,
traditions.KJV: Then he went down into the king ’s house ,

traditions.WLC: עַל לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַ סֹּפֵ֔ר
traditions.LXX: εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ γραμματέως ,
traditions.VUL: ad gazophylácium scribæ ,
traditions.KJV: into the scribe ’s chamber :

12.english_reference: and , lo , all the princes sat there

traditions.WLC: וְ הִ֨נֵּה שָׁ֔ם כָּל הַ שָּׂרִ֖ים יֽוֹשְׁבִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐκεῖ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες ἐκάθηντο ,
traditions.VUL: et ecce ibi omnes príncipes sedébant :
traditions.KJV: and , lo , all the princes sat there , [ even ]

12.english_reference: [ even ] Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes

traditions.WLC: אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַ סֹּפֵ֡ר וּ דְלָיָ֣הוּ בֶן שְׁ֠מַעְיָהוּ וְ אֶלְנָתָ֨ן בֶּן עַכְבּ֜וֹר וּ גְמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן שָׁפָ֛ן וְ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן חֲנַנְיָ֖הוּ וְ כָל הַ שָּׂרִֽים
traditions.LXX: Ἐλεισαμὰ ὁ γραμματεὺς καὶ Δαλαίας υἱὸς Σελεμίου καὶ Ἰωναθὰν υἱὸς Ἀκχοβὼρ καὶ Γαμαρίας υἱὸς Σαφὰν καὶ Σεδεκίας υἱὸς Ἁνανίου καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες ,
traditions.VUL: Elísama scriba , et Dalaías fílius Semeíæ , et Elnathan fílius Achobor , et Gamarías fílius Saphan , et Sedecías fílius Hananíæ , et univérsi príncipes .
traditions.KJV: Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .

13.english_reference: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּגֵּ֤ד לָ הֶם֙ מִכָ֔יְהוּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמֵ֑עַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς Μειχαίας πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἤκουσεν
traditions.VUL: Et nuntiávit eis Michǽas ómnia verba , quæ audívit

traditions.KJV: Take thee again another roll ,

28.english_reference: and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll

traditions.WLC: וּ כְתֹ֣ב עָלֶ֗י הָ אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ דְּבָרִים֙ הָ רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֗וּ עַל הַ מְּגִלָּה֙ הָ רִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: et scribe in eo omnes sermónes prióres , qui erant in primo volúmine ,
traditions.KJV: and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll ,

28.english_reference: which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֖ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.VUL: quod combússit Ióakim rex Iuda .
traditions.KJV: which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned .

29.english_reference: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah , Thus saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Et ad Ióakim regem Iuda dices : Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah , Thus saith the LORD ;

29.english_reference: Thou hast burned this roll , saying , Why hast thou written therein , saying ,

traditions.WLC: אַ֠תָּה שָׂרַ֜פְתָּ אֶת הַ מְּגִלָּ֤ה הַ זֹּאת֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר מַדּוּעַ֩ כָּתַ֨בְתָּ עָלֶ֜י הָ לֵ אמֹ֗ר
traditions.VUL: Tu combussísti volúmen illud , dicens : Quare scripsísti in eo annúntians :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast burned this roll , saying , Why hast thou written therein , saying ,

29.english_reference: The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land

traditions.WLC: בֹּֽא יָב֤וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ וְ הִשְׁחִית֙ אֶת הָ אָ֣רֶץ הַ זֹּ֔את
traditions.VUL: Festínus véniet rex Babylónis , et vastábit terram hanc ,
traditions.KJV: The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land ,

29.english_reference: and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast ?

traditions.WLC: וְ הִשְׁבִּ֥ית מִמֶּ֖ נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּ בְהֵמָֽה
traditions.VUL: et cessáre fáciet ex illa hóminem et iuméntum ?
traditions.KJV: and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast ?

30.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל יְהֽוֹיָקִים֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus contra Ióakim regem Iuda :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah ;

30.english_reference: He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David

traditions.WLC: לֹא יִֽהְיֶה לּ֥ וֹ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד
traditions.VUL: Non erit ex eo , qui sédeat super sólium David :
traditions.KJV: He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David :

30.english_reference: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat , and in the night to the frost

traditions.WLC: וְ נִבְלָת וֹ֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה מֻשְׁלֶ֔כֶת לַ חֹ֥רֶב בַּ יּ֖וֹם וְ לַ קֶּ֥רַח בַּ לָּֽיְלָה
traditions.VUL: et cadáver eius proiciétur ad æstum per diem , et ad gelu per noctem .
traditions.KJV: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat , and in the night to the frost .

31.english_reference: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity

traditions.WLC: וּ פָקַדְתִּ֨י עָלָ֧י ו וְ עַל זַרְע֛ וֹ וְ עַל עֲבָדָ֖י ו אֶת עֲוֺנָ֑ ם
traditions.VUL: Et visitábo contra eum , et contra semen eius , et contra servos eius , iniquitátes suas :
traditions.KJV: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity ;

31.english_reference: and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵבֵאתִ֣י עֲ֠לֵי הֶם וְ עַל יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וְ אֶל אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֧ת כָּל הָ רָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵי הֶ֖ם
traditions.VUL: et addúcam super eos , et super habitatóres Ierúsalem , et super viros Iuda , omne malum , quod locútus sum ad eos ,
traditions.KJV: and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them ;

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ
traditions.VUL: et non audiérunt .
traditions.KJV: but they hearkened not .

traditions.WLC: וְ יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לָקַ֣ח מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֗רֶת
traditions.VUL: Ieremías autem tulit volúmen áliud ,
traditions.KJV: Then took Jeremiah another roll ,

32.english_reference: and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנָ הּ֮ אֶל בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן נֵרִיָּהוּ֮ הַ סֹּפֵר֒
traditions.VUL: et dedit illud Baruch fílio Neríæ scribæ :
traditions.KJV: and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah ;

32.english_reference: who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְתֹּ֤ב עָלֶ֨י הָ֙ מִ פִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ סֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֛ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּ אֵ֑שׁ
traditions.VUL: qui scripsit in eo ex ore Ieremíæ omnes sermónes libri , quem combússerat Ióakim rex Iuda igni :
traditions.KJV: who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire :

32.english_reference: and there were added besides unto them many like words

traditions.WLC: וְ ע֨וֹד נוֹסַ֧ף עֲלֵי הֶ֛ם דְּבָרִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים כָּ הֵֽמָּה
traditions.VUL: et ínsuper ádditi sunt sermónes multo plures , quam ántea fúerant .
traditions.KJV: and there were added besides unto them many like words .
